about: Clips whose art EmberEngine replaces (Engine2's file stays untouched in C:/Engine2). Applied to the battle pack's manifest and the heroes file by tools/scripts/sprites/apply_sprite_overrides.py. Paths are relative to the repo root.

speed.why: the user, 2026-10-17: Malrec's casting and ATT are far too slow (his clips run 3.33 s at 10.8 fps, then the fight plays them at its pace: more than 5 s a cast)

sets.why: the user, 2026-10-17: Voss cut from their Veo videos (Attachments/VeoVoss) as a new sprite set, his default; voss-final kept (its back pose stays on Poison Breath); every native frame, the video's own resolution

the user, 2026-10-21: "deixar todos em ~610 px", then "com a opção de medium e high nas configurações de video, o padrão será medium": idle, both walks, attack and staff counter at ~610 px of figure (like cast, hit and death); Personagens Média (default) draws them, Alta voss-veo's full resolution

clips.why: the user's second sheet (Attachments/Salazar/Walkright2, ludo.ai, 7 x 7, 79 ms a frame), 2026-10-17. As drawn, the boot on the ground climbs 12-19 px in the cell during each stance and drops back (frames 3-22: 613 -> 601, 28-48: 617 -> 598), so with the card's feet fixed he floated off the ground and fell back. Each frame moved up / down by whole pixels (no resampling) so the boot standing on the ground sits on row 610 in every frame (scratchpad align_sole.py: lowest row of a solid boot 16 rows tall, which skips the opaque contact-shadow ghosts under frames 23-24 / 46-47). v02 (the first sheet) stays in content/sprites

poses.boxNote: same figure size and feet line as Engine2's clip: its figure 473 px tall at 3.3843 / 613 units a pixel, 13 px of margin under the feet; this art's figure is 599 px tall with 12 px under the feet
